system.description:
At Level 5, the peak of natural Gargoyle flight, you can take off vertically while carrying up to 200 pounds - enough to carry most Kindred, or prey, bodily through the air.

Skilled fliers can also perform special aerial combat maneuvers such as Pounce, Swoop, and Slam, each with its own Ability/Discipline prerequisites; learning a maneuver costs a Free Trait at character creation or two experience points afterward, and attempting an unlearned maneuver you otherwise qualify for requires bidding three extra Physical Traits, with a failed challenge causing a crash, one health level of damage, and a lost turn recovering.
